item.title: Sado Taraibune: Paddle a Traditional Round Tub Boat — Guide
item.description: Taraibune, the distinctive round wooden ‘tub boats’ found on Sado Island, were originally developed by local fisherwomen in the late 19th century to navigate the narrow, rocky coves along the island’s southern coast, where conventional boat shapes struggled to manoeuvre while gathering shellfish and seaweed. Today, visitors can ride and even try paddling these unusual round vessels themselves, guided by experienced local boat handlers along calm, sheltered coastal waters, offering a genuinely unique hands-on maritime experience found nowhere else in Japan.
